confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a July 2026 low-season window; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel prices vary widely by beach area and are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set from beer-relative ratios (about 2.5x and 2.25x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. Restaurant and hotel figures assume typical tourist-area service charge and VAT and roughly 32-34 THB per USD. The FX value comes from search-result snippets of the RBA exchange-rates page; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against other Thai and Southeast Asian beach-resort destinations with similar tourism pricing (for example Krabi and Koh Samui), with hotel and hostel prices adjusted for July rainy-season discounting. No specific city listing or dataset was used.
